description: R9 makes revenue_today_usd <= revenue_mo_usd a validated invariant at ingestion. enrichOnChain OVERWRITES both from two INDEPENDENT reader calls: externalInflowsUsd(id, midnight, ex) and (id, monthStart, ex) (enrich.js:33-34). Nothing enforces monotonicity between the two reads. A live reader that queries today and month separately can observe an inflow that landed between the two calls (or any reader inconsistency) and produce revenue_today_usd > revenue_mo_usd. aggregate consumes the enriched row WITHOUT re-running validate(), so an R9-invalid figure flows straight to the served leaderboard. The invariant is checked on inbound self-reports but discarded on the authoritative chain path.

evidence.snippet: e.revenue_mo_usd = reader.externalInflowsUsd(row.id, mStart, ex); e.revenue_today_usd = reader.externalInflowsUsd(row.id, midnight, ex);

fix: Clamp revenue_today_usd = min(today, mo) after the reads, or re-validate the enriched row and flag unverified on violation.
